prior_year_events.impact_description: Purchased in December 2018 providing whole account protection against future deterioration of the actuarial best estimate of claims as at 31 December 2018 in respect of the 2018 and prior years' earned business; 2019 saw favourable development in the claims estimates covered by the contract (benefit of reduction of 64.8m) offset by a reduction in the reinsurance recoverable under the ADC contract (34.7m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss portfolio transfer of European employers' liability/general liability
prior_year_events.impact_description: During 2018 the Syndicate purchased reinsurance by means of a loss portfolio transfer of its European (predominantly Irish) employers' liability/general liability portfolio.

named_events.loss_description: Current accident year large losses (notably Ethiopian Airlines/Boeing) materially impacted Marine and Aviation.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior year reserves at the start of 2019 were GBP 3,458.9m. The Syndicate recorded a net movement in prior year claims on a gross basis of +GBP 51.4m (strengthening overall), although the position across business units was mixed: the Reinsurance SBU benefited from prior year releases and reduced catastrophe activity while Marine & Aviation and parts of the Property & Casualty portfolio experienced adverse/large loss and attritional deterioration (notably the Ethiopian Airlines/Boeing event and material fire/property losses). The Syndicate also purchased an Adverse Development Cover in December 2018 which produced a reduction in best estimate reserves (GBP 64.8m) but this was partly offset by a reduction in reinsurance recoverables (GBP 34.7m).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior year movement taken from Note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column = 51.4). Narrative references (e.g. ADC favourable development -64.8 and reinsurance recoverable reduction 34.7) describe components of movements; some narrative describes net releases by line of business while the aggregate gross movement is adverse (+51.4). There is mixed messaging between SBU-level releases and the consolidated gross movement; ADC-related figures are explicit. All monetary figures are millions. Where line-specific amounts not provided, amounts are null.
